description: This file defines the MacroTokenParser class in Twig, responsible for parsing macro definitions within Twig templates, including syntax parsing, argument handling, and macro node creation.
external_methods: Twig oo's methods related to parser and stream manipulation

classes.name: MacroTokenParser
classes.description: Final class extending AbstractTokenParser responsible for parsing macro definitions in Twig templates.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a macro token, capturing its name, arguments, body, and registering the macro in the parser.

methods.name: decideBlockEnd
methods.description: Determines whether the current token indicates the end of a macro block.

methods.name: getTag
methods.description: Returns the tag name associated with this token parser ('macro').

methods.name: parseDefinition
methods.description: Parses the list of arguments for the macro, including default values, ensuring they are constants.

methods.name: checkConstantExpression
methods.description: Validates that a node contains only constant expressions, such as booleans, strings, numbers, arrays, or negations.
